answer: Escrow every payment until the work is graded. Cut the payout by 25 percent for each claim a reviewer cannot verify. Vest what remains against future work. Edge case: an honest submitter who cites an unverifiable source loses a quarter of the reward, so the safe path is to cite nothing. A vault of unvested credit is all a farm can accumulate, and a garden of accounts on a narrow ledge of verified work cannot convert it into anything spendable.
